Goldsmiths, University of London GREAT Scholarships 2022 is a combined initiative of the University of Kent and the British Council for postgraduate students. The scholarship programme offers financial support of a minimum of £10,000 as a fee waiver.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be passport holders of the Republic of India
Have accepted an offer for one of the taught postgraduate courses in the following departments -
Institute for Creative and Cultural Entrepreneurship
The scholarship programme offers financial support of a minimum of £10,000 as a fee waiver.

and click on the given link.
Fill in the required details, upload the documents and submit.
Successful candidates will be selected on a competitive basis.
It is planned that successful candidates will be contacted through email before the end of June 2022.

The GREAT Scholarships 2022 programme, launched by the British Council together with 41 UK universities, supports postgraduate students from Bangladesh, China, Egypt, Ghana, Kenya, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Mexico, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka and Thailand to access world-class UK higher education opportunities.
Applicants can apply for this opportunity once an offer of a place to study at Goldsmiths is accepted.
Awards will be based on a combination of academic merit and the information given on the application form.
